marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Hardware Expenditure
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported quarterly capex increases driven by AI infrastructure building, while semiconductor stocks experienced mixed performance due to supply-chain delivery timelines.
marketLayer.inference: Strong hardware demand supports foundational chipmakers, but investors are increasingly demanding visible return on investment from enterprise AI applications.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization speed of downstream enterprise software and potential margin compression from high depreciation costs.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet Giants & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw increased trading activity with net Southbound inflows targeting leading platform economy and EV auto companies during market pullbacks.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional investors continue to deploy capital into HK-listed tech leaders showing strong buyback programs and stabilizing revenue growth.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persisting competition in domestic e-commerce price wars and potential foreign capital allocation shifts based on global macro signals.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Outlook & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: U.S. treasury yields drifted lower following fresh inflation and employment indicators that signaled a gradual cooling of the economy.
marketLayer.inference: Lower yield pressures tend to provide valuation relief for growth equities in both US and HK markets, encouraging risk-on sentiment in dividend and rate-sensitive assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky core service inflation data that could cause Fed officials to delay monetary easing expectations.
